Subject: RFP Appendix A — IP / Escrow / Export controls clarifications

Monica,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the RFP. Our legal/procurement team reviewed Appendix A and has three items needing clarification before we can proceed to the order-form redline:

1) IP/Ownership: The RFP asks for assignment/licensing language for derivatives built from customer prompts and data. Please confirm whether Redwood is proposing (a) assignment of new IP to Entanglia, (b) a customer perpetual license, or (c) a hybrid (assignment limited to derivative application code, model weights remain Redwood-owned).

2) Escrow for model weights: We have a requirement in our procurement policy for escrow of select deliverables for critical AI components in the event of vendor insolvency. We need to know if Redwood will agree to a third-party escrow for model artifacts (weights) or an alternative (e.g., managed export of frozen checkpoints to an escrow agent). Please include proposed terms (trigger events, retrieval rights, verification process).

3) Export controls & restricted output: Because some of our use cases involve regulated geographies, we need to confirm Redwood's approach to export controls, restricted country lists, and whether you will include a warranty/indemnity carveout for violations caused by customer data or customer-requested outputs.

Please see attached Appendix A (we added line numbers). Can you provide a short answers document and any sample clause text by EOD 5/19? If a call is easier, procurement is available Wednesday afternoon PT.

Regards,
Asha Kapoor

Entanglia Systems

Monica — drafted responses below. I also attached clause text and an IP matrix for internal review. High-level positions first, then suggested contract language.

High-level positions (recommended)
- IP: Redwood will not assign core model weights or base model IP. We offer a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use the delivered model endpoints or a delivered customer‑specific snapshot for the term of the order. For customer-created prompt datasets and customer-supplied code, we are willing to discuss assignment of customer-side application code or exclusive rights in customer-trained artifacts if Redwood performs custom training under an SOW; otherwise, license.

- Escrow: For hosted service (Redwood API), we cannot escrow live model weights. For Dedicated/Private deployments, we will agree to escrow a frozen checkpoint under these conditions: (a) escrow limited to customer-specific checkpoints (not Redwood base models), (b) escrow triggered on vendor insolvency, material breach with cure failure, or as mutually agreed, (c) retrieval limited to customer and verified by appointed third-party auditor. We propose an escrow fee to cover verification and retrieval costs.

- Export controls & indemnity carveout: We will comply with applicable export laws. We propose a warranty that Redwood will not intentionally export to embargoed jurisdictions and will maintain processes to block restricted flows. We cannot provide a broad indemnity for customer misuse (for example, customer deliberately prompts generation of restricted technical know-how); propose a carveout where indemnity does not apply to customer-directed actions or to outputs that violate export controls solely because of customer-provided restricted data.

Suggested liability cap & exceptions
- Base liability cap: 1x the annualized fees paid under the order (standard).
- Exceptions: carve out (no cap) for willful misconduct, gross negligence, or Redwood's material breach of confidentiality/security obligations that results in regulatory fines. For export-control violations resulting from Redwood's breach of its compliance obligations, we propose treating them as a confidentiality/security exception. For violations caused solely by customer actions (e.g., customer submits restricted tech and directs output), we propose indemnity does not apply and liability limited to direct damages up to the base cap.

Attachments included for Entanglia redlines: RI_escrow_clause_v1.txt (escrow triggers/process), IP_assignment_matrix.xlsx (examples by deliverable), Redwood_orderform_redline_20260519.docx (proposed redlines).

Open items where I want your input:
- Monetary escrow fee: recommend passing through direct third-party costs + 10% admin; OK to propose?
- If Entanglia insists on escrow for hosted weights, we should offer a compromise: periodic export of frozen, customer-specific snapshots to an escrow agent, with access controls and encryption keys held by the escrow agent. That preserves our IP while satisfying their procurement.

If you're good with this, I'll convert the language into a concise answers doc for Entanglia and include the clause text.

—Rishi

Redwood Inference

Asha — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a short answers document and two clause options (hosted vs private). High level:

- IP: Redwood does not assign base model weights. We grant a perpetual, non-exclusive license to customer for model artifacts produced under the order. For custom models trained under an SOW, we are open to grant broader rights (see IP matrix).

- Escrow: For Dedicated/Private deployments we will escrow customer-specific frozen checkpoints. For hosted API we propose an alternative: encrypted customer snapshots deposited with a neutral escrow agent on a periodic schedule; retrieval only upon specified trigger events. Escrow costs would be borne by Entanglia per our proposed fee schedule.

- Export controls & indemnity: Redwood will maintain compliance processes and a warranty about not intentionally exporting to embargoed jurisdictions. We cannot accept indemnity for customer-directed misuse; we propose the carveouts and the liability cap approach Rishi outlined (base cap = 1x annual fees; exceptions for willful misconduct/confidentiality/security breaches).

Next steps: Please review the attached Redwood_RFP_Appendix_Responses.docx and the escrow clause options. If Entanglia is comfortable, we can schedule a 30-minute procurement/legal call on Wed 5/20 at 2pm PT to walk redlines. If you have internal redline markup, please send by COB Thursday 5/21.

Attachments: Redwood_RFP_Appendix_Responses.docx; RI_escrow_clause_v1.txt
